content.what_it_is: UPDATE_MASK recomputes wet/dry MASK from local free-surface and four-neighbor conditions over a two-cell halo (L83-L121), adjusts interface depths for cells regarded as dry (L123-L135), replaces MASK (L141), derives a nine-point MASK9 unless viscosity breaking bypasses it (L146-L164), exchanges both integer masks, and releases temporaries (L167-L175).
entities: allocatable integer MASKtmp and MASK9tmp L65

equations.expr: MASK9tmp=product of center and eight neighboring MASK values

unresolved: ETAtmp is allocated at L70 but its only visible initialization, ETAtmp=ETA, is commented at L79; the drying branch nevertheless reads ETAtmp(I,J) in the Dmass equation at L117. Dmass therefore incorporates undefined allocation contents whenever a wet cell dries.

Wet/dry decisions are written to MASKtmp at L91-L112 but the interface-depth correction at L130 tests the old MASK, because MASK is not replaced by MASKtmp until L141. Newly flooded cells still satisfy old MASK<1 and are treated as dry for DepthX/DepthY, while newly dried cells still have old MASK==1 and skip the correction.

MASK9tmp is allocated over all Mloc,Nloc at L69 but assigned only on Ibeg-1:Iend+1 and Jbeg-1:Jend+1 at L146-L162 before the whole array is copied at L164. If the allocated halo extends beyond that range, untouched elements are undefined until or unless PHI_INT_EXCH at L168 fills every such position.
